result.title: Cross-Loop Query Handoff: How Later Loops Redirect Two-Hop Retrieval in the Ouro Looped Language Models
result.comment: Code and reproducibility: https://github.com/Muuzzziiy/cql-handoff 16 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables
result.summary: How do later loops in a pretrained looped language model repair two-hop retrieval? We study Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B by transplanting attention queries between loops at the same layer, head and final prompt position. On synthetic in-context questions, injecting the layer-indexed collection of loop-3 queries throughout loop 1 rescues 90% and 97% of questions answered incorrectly at loop 1 and correctly at loop 3, versus 24% and 21% for shuffled donors. The rescue also holds under greedy generation in Ouro-2.6B; in Ouro-1.4B it is limited to four-candidate ranking. Crossed donor-recipient swaps favor retrieval through the donor's bridge entity over copying its answer, although a substantial positional component remains in Ouro-2.6B. Late keys and values rescue far fewer targets. Freezing queries at their loop-1 values also damages two-hop accuracy more than a matched question that supplies the bridge. On natural questions, rescue is smaller and replicates only in Ouro-2.6B, and crossed swaps do not establish bridge redirection. These results identify a transferable collection of late-loop queries that supports bridge-conditioned retrieval on synthetic scenes; they do not locate where the bridge is computed or establish a single-vector handoff.

AI.brief_summary: 该文以 Ouro-1.4B/2.6B 循环语言模型为对象，在同层、同头、同末尾提示位置于不同 loop 间移植 attention query，考察后段循环如何修复合成情境下的两跳检索；发现把 loop-3 的 query 集合注入 loop 1 能挽救约九成错误样本，而晚期 key/value 效果明显更弱。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是纯文本循环模型的机制干预研究，不直接涉及视觉输入，但其「哪一循环的 query 携带可迁移的检索重定向信息」可供核查 LVR 中 loop 式状态更新、跨迭代信息贡献分配与注意力结构的作用。
